# Temporarily disabled so it doesn't run automatically

name: CD

# Publishes the Docker image to GitHub Container Registry when the CI passes on main,
# and for every version tag (v1.2.3).
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  push:
    tags: ['v*']

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  docker:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # For workflow_run, build exactly the commit the CI validated.
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        id: meta
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' }}
            type=sha
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}

      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  # Optional: set the repository variable DEPLOY_ENABLED=true and the secrets DEPLOY_HOST,
  # DEPLOY_USER and DEPLOY_SSH_KEY to roll the new image out to a server with docker compose.
  deploy:
    needs: docker
    if: vars.DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.2.0
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            docker compose pull
            docker compose up -d
